rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Rossiyskaya Gazeta officially publishes CEC resolution No. 152/1255-7 of 23 March 2018 with its annex under 'Дата подписания 23 марта 2018 г. Опубликован 24 марта 2018 г.': 73,578,992 voters took part in the voting, and 'Путина Владимира Владимировича', with 56,430,712 votes (76.69 per cent), is deemed elected President of the Russian Federation.
rows.locator: Issue line; signing and publication lines; points 1-3

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The annex gives votes per registered candidate (per cent of voters taking part in the voting): Baburin 479,013 (0.65), Grudinin 8,659,206 (11.77), Zhirinovsky 4,154,985 (5.65), Putin 56,430,712 (76.69), Sobchak 1,238,031 (1.68), Suraikin 499,342 (0.68), Titov 556,801 (0.76), Yavlinsky 769,644 (1.05).
